stories.title: Sources: Panthers RB Brooks set for surgery, out at least 6 weeks
stories.summary: Panthers running back Jonathon Brooks is expected to undergo surgery to repair a core muscle injury and is set to miss at least six weeks, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Sources: Giants QB Dart out for extended period, possibly rest of season
stories.summary: Jaxson Dart's knee injury is more severe than originally anticipated, and the Giants quarterback could miss the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

stories.title: Spatola, ESPN college basketball analyst and former Army guard, dies at 47
stories.summary: Chris Spatola, an ESPN college basketball analyst and former Army starting guard, has died at age 47, the network announced on Tuesday.
